# Speedtest by Ookla

> Speedtest by Ookla is a global broadband and mobile network testing platform for measuring internet performance across web, mobile, desktop, TV, and command-line apps.

Speedtest provides free tools to test download speed, upload speed, latency, jitter, packet loss, video streaming quality, and mobile network coverage. The platform also offers apps for major operating systems, a command-line interface for automation, internet performance maps, and outage visibility through related Ookla services.

## Core Speed Test Experience
- [Speedtest Web](https://www.speedtest.net/): Run a browser-based internet speed test for download, upload, ping, jitter, and packet loss.
- [Results](https://www.speedtest.net/result/): View and share individual Speedtest result pages with detailed connection metrics and history.
- [Global Index](https://www.speedtest.net/global-index): Compare internet and mobile performance rankings by country and city worldwide.
- [Speedtest Custom](https://www.speedtest.net/custom): Create branded speed tests for organizations, ISPs, and businesses.
- [Speedtest Server Network](https://www.speedtest.net/servers): Explore the global network of Speedtest servers used for performance measurements.

## Apps and Downloads
- [Apps Overview](https://www.speedtest.net/apps): Browse Speedtest apps for mobile, desktop, TV, and command-line platforms.
- [Android App](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/android): Download the Speedtest app for Android devices and mobile network testing.
- [iOS App](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/ios): Download the Speedtest app for iPhone and iPad to test connection performance.
- [macOS App](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/mac): Get the native Speedtest app for macOS desktops and laptops.
- [Windows App](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/windows): Install the Speedtest desktop app for Windows systems.
- [Apple TV App](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/appletv): Test internet performance directly from an Apple TV device.
- [CLI](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/cli): Use Speedtest from the command line for scripting, automation, and diagnostics.

## Mobile and Device Platforms
- [Chrome Extension](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/chrome): Run Speedtest from a Chrome browser extension.
- [Android Availability](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.zwanoo.android.speedtest): Official Google Play listing for the Speedtest Android app.

## Network Intelligence and Maps
- [Speedtest Maps](https://www.speedtest.net/maps): View mobile coverage and fixed broadband performance maps by region.
- [Global Index Methodology](https://www.speedtest.net/global-index): Review comparative rankings for broadband and mobile network performance.
- [Downdetector](https://downdetector.com/): Check real-time outage reports for internet services, apps, and platforms.
- [Ookla](https://www.ookla.com/): Learn about Ookla’s broader network intelligence and connectivity measurement products.
